decision.decision_evidence: Merged PR 36 adopted schema-first structural validation while preserving the semantic validator.

state_before: Portable Case Pack v1 structural rules were published but not executed against instances in CI.
state_after: Portable Case Pack v1 instances are structurally validated against the published Draft 2020-12 schema before semantic validation, with four negative mutation regression anchors.
earliest_failure_point: The CI path validated the JSON syntax of the schema document but did not execute that schema against Portable Case Pack instances.
human_corrections: Treat the published JSON Schema as the structural authority rather than assuming the handwritten semantic validator fully implements it.
Do not use the parity fix to silently tighten unresolved derived-claim evidence semantics.
remaining_unknowns: Whether every derived claim must carry evidence in a future Portable Case Pack contract version.
Whether the public Evidence Wayfinding workflow produces measurable Senior Attention value in private live cases.

failure_point_candidate.candidate_scope: schema-validation ordering and contract-parity regression protection
